column1: # Upstream's security audit issues (storytold/figcraft, titled "[Audit] ...", filed 22 Oct 2026 against rev 9ec80bf2) and the upstream commits that closed them (from each issue's closing pull requests). Columns: issue, state (O open, C closed), severity, title, fix commits.

column4: [Audit] 4 defects with evidence + patches: collab counter overflow, failed batch wipes redo stack, name counter overflow, page.move corruption
[Audit] COL-1: Client-id takeover through Hello.resume (High)
[Audit] PLG-1: Read-only plugin can upload the document over the network (High)
[Audit] ENG-1: Document-named library paths reach UNC shares (NTLM leak) (High (Windows))
[Audit] FMT-1: .fig (kiwi) value budget skips single scalar fields (High)
[Audit] FMT-2: Uncapped issue list in Document::validate (High)
[Audit] FMT-3: .fig embedded image bytes copied once per hash (High)
[Audit] RND-1: Dash count not bounded against path length (High)
[Audit] RND-2: Nested isolated layers allocate full-view pixmaps with no total (High)
[Audit] ENG-2: Unbounded world_render_bounds recursion (High)
[Audit] COL-2: Quadratic fixes() for a refused batch (High)
[Audit] ENG-3: Stale next_id makes paste_nodes overwrite existing nodes (High)
[Audit] COL-3: O(n^2) sibling placement on the single hub thread (Medium-High)
[Audit] COL-4: is_ancestor fails open after 10,000 steps (Medium)
[Audit] COL-5: Id-space exhaustion blocks all future joins (Medium)
[Audit] COL-6: Pre-authentication slowloris (Medium)
[Audit] COL-7: Unbounded replay log on desktop host and private servers (Medium)
[Audit] COL-8: Kicked connections aren't shut and keep their queue budget (Medium)
[Audit] PLG-2: Plugins can read files and reach UNC paths via text.loadFont (Medium)
[Audit] IPC-1: Unauthenticated local control channel (Medium)
[Audit] SRV-1: Per-address quotas count only the /64 (Medium)
[Audit] SRV-2: Join/leave of an idle file causes I/O amplification on the hub thread (Medium)
[Audit] SRV-3: Owner admin requests limited only by message rate (Medium)
[Audit] FMT-4: .fig zip images have no total budget (Medium)
[Audit] FMT-5: Instance expansion of uncounted layers / override cloning is quadratic (Medium)
[Audit] FMT-6: validate/repair/library manifest checks are O(n^2) (Medium)
[Audit] FMT-7: Per-area decompression caps add up to ~8GB for one .figcraft (Medium)
[Audit] RND-3: SVG pattern tile re-rendered per use with reset node budget (Medium)
[Audit] RND-4: Nesting pre-scan skips DTD bodies; entity expansion passes MAX_NESTING (Medium)
[Audit] RND-5: Render worker/rayon stacks are 2MiB; pattern sources restart depth at 0 (Medium)
[Audit] RND-6: Grid auto-placement is O(children x rows x span^2) (Medium)
[Audit] ENG-4: Mutually containing components aren't refused (Medium)
[Audit] ENG-5: normalize runs outside guard; grouped restore skipped on unwind (Medium)
[Audit] COL-9: Image entries accepted under any hash; width/height unchecked (Low-Medium)
[Audit] COL-10: Message size limit raised to full size before token check (Low)
[Audit] SRV-4: A correct join code resets the wrong-code streak (Low)
[Audit] SRV-5: Libraries/plugins larger than the 16MiB burst can never be downloaded (Low)
[Audit] SRV-6: Any log read error discards confirmed edits (Low)
[Audit] SRV-7: Read-only-looking CLI commands run the expiry sweep (Low)
[Audit] SRV-8: Editor can freeze a team library with version = u64::MAX (Low)
[Audit] SRV-9: New file's directory entry is not fsynced (Low)
[Audit] IPC-2: Automation roots canonicalize UNC paths before refusing them (Low-Medium)
[Audit] IPC-3: Automation roots confine files only; network remains open (Low)
[Audit] IPC-4: Prototype can open unlimited URLs without a click (Low)
[Audit] IPC-5: Opening a document contacts any library server it names (beacon) (Low)

[Audit] ENG-7: command.batch keeps a full undo snapshot per step (Low)
[Audit] ENG-8: Rollback restores doc/selection/page only, not clipboard or history (Low)
[Audit] FMT-8: 256-level recursion with large frames on wasm's 1MB stack (Low-Medium)
[Audit] RND-7: Text style dedupe is O(spans x styles) while holding the font-db lock (Low-Medium)
[Audit] RND-8: Morphology is O(w*h*r) with r <= 400 (Low)
[Audit] RND-9: Boolean ops have no input-complexity cap (Low)
[Audit] RND-10: Many full-size RGBA buffers in flight in krilla's async deflate (Low)
[Audit] RND-11: unique_id is O(n^2) for repeated layer names (Low)
[Audit] DEP-1: zip 2.6.1 has three extract-only advisories; not reachable today (Low)
[Audit] DEP-2: tokio yanked; unmaintained rustybuzz/ttf-parser/zvariant (Info)
[Audit] DEP-3: No deny.toml; audit/deny not in CI; release has no overflow-checks (Info)
